basic_info.description: Modern & Elegant 2-Story, 3BD/2BA Single-Family Home in the Desirable Excelsior Neighborhood.  Behind its sleek facade lies a space where natural bamboo hardwood floors flow seamlessly throughout, complemented by abundant natural light that fills the open, airy layout. The main level features a sun-drenched living and dining area, and the gourmet kitchen is a chefs dream, with custom cabinetry, luxurious marble countertops, and stainless steel appliances. This level also includes two bedrooms, one full bath with rain shower and jetted tub, and direct access to a private deck that overlooks a beautiful backyard. The lower level offers even more living space, including a third bedroom with dual closets and an ensuite bath, as well as a cozy family room/office. The home also features a one-car garage with storage area, and washer/dryer installed. The backyard is a gardeners paradise, with a grassy lawn, and plenty of space for planting. Located just one block from the Crocker-Amazon Playground and McLaren Park, a 313-acre outdoor recreation haven. This home offers easy access to schools, shopping, and public transportation. A must-see!
